texte.Ces trois-là sont déterministes, sans mo: These three are deterministic, without a language model — and that is a choice.
texte.Chacune mène à son bloc. Aucune n’est ob: Each one leads to its block. None is mandatory, none blocks the next: the thread guides, it does not confine.
texte.Chaque donnée porte-t-elle sa date de pr: Does each piece of data carry its production date AND its validity period?
texte.Choisissez selon la question qui vous re: Choose according to the question you still have.
texte.Cibler les sources, outiller la collecte: Target the sources, tool the collection, qualify the data, time-stamp it.
texte.Comment choisir, en une question :: How to choose, in one question:
texte.Conception de la stratégie incendie et d: Design of the fire strategy and of the systems that serve it: compartmentation, smoke extraction, detection, automatic extinguishing. Distinct from the SSI coordinator, who does not design but makes what several work packages supply hold together. — RATE NOT RECORDED: The survey files fire safety under miscellaneous engineering consultants. On a data centre it decides the architecture — compartmentation, smoke extraction, automatic extinguishing — and deserves its own line.
texte.Critères objectifs de maturité, KPI de p: Objective maturity criteria, steering KPIs, sustained upkeep.
texte.Création de valeur — EVA, ROCE, free cas: Value creation — EVA, ROCE, free cash flow
texte.Côté investissement : combien d'équipeme: On the investment side: how much equipment the IT power requires, at what indicative price, and what share of the total. On the footprint side: its manufacturing carbon in the
texte.De deux à six pays comparés. En dessous: Two to six countries compared. Below two, there is nothing to compare.
texte.Des données brutes ne deviennent des élé: Raw data only becomes decision material through a grid — and a purely quantitative grid misses what really decides a site: local acceptability, grid connection lead time, availability of skills.
texte.Des jalons de réévaluation sont-ils posé: Are reassessment milestones set in the calendar?
texte.Descentes de charges, planchers techniqu: Load paths, raised floors, structural strengthening. The weight of chillers and UPS units is handled here.
texte.Deux chemins vers le site d’ingénierie,: Two paths to the engineering site, and they do not carry the same thing.
texte.D’où vient la valeur — Coût moyen pondér: Where the value comes from — Weighted average cost of capital (%)
texte.D’où vient la valeur — Taux d'impôt sur: Where the value comes from — Corporate income tax rate (%)
texte.D’où vient le coût au mégawatt, et ce qu: Where the cost per megawatt comes from, and what it does not say.
texte.EVA, ROCE, free cash flow : le projet le: EVA, ROCE, free cash flow: the cheapest project is not always the one that creates value.
texte.En combien d'années le site atteint-il s: In how many years does the site reach its nominal load?
texte.Enveloppe non calculée : lancez-la plus: Envelope not calculated: run it above so that the share can be calculated.
texte.Explication : Coût moyen pondéré du capi: Explanation: Weighted average cost of capital (%)
texte.Exécution, direction des travaux et réce: Construction, works supervision and handover — Site monitoring, approval of progress claims, testing, clearing of snags and the as-built file.
texte.Grille analytique, méthodes qualitative: Analytical grid, qualitative AND quantitative methods.
texte.Groupes froid, groupes électrogènes et t: Chillers, generators and towers: noise is the leading cause of neighbourhood disputes for a data centre, and it is dealt with at design stage.
texte.Honoraires de maîtrise d’œuvre — par mis: Project management fees — by engagement and by phase
texte.IE · SE · FR — le premier sert de référe: IE · SE · FR — the first serves as the reference
texte.Il ne conçoit pas : il fait tenir ensemb: The coordinator does not design: they make what several work packages supply hold together — detection, smoke extraction, doors, compartmentation, technical shutdowns — and carry the SSI identity file through to handover. The workload lies in construction and testing, not in the studies: this is what the breakdown shows. — RATE NOT RECORDED: Absent from the survey. It is not optional for all that: SSI coordination falls under standard NF S #-# and is required as soon as the fire safety system falls into the categories that demand it. THIS MODULE DOES NOT QUALIFY THE CATEGORY of the SSI — just as it qualifies neither the ICPE classification nor whether technical inspection is required.
texte.Il provient d’un relevé publié —: It comes from a published survey —
texte.Ingénierie financière — équipements, val: Financial engineering — equipment, value, maturity, steering
texte.LE bureau d'études d'un centre de donnée: THE engineering consultant of a data centre. Its rate is FOUR TIMES higher on the technical package: this is where PUE, the cooling mode and water consumption are decided.
Consistency between the engineering consultants. It stops at the signing of the contracts: it is a design engagement, not a construction one.
texte.La collecte est-elle outillée — automati: Is the collection tooled — automated or, failing that, described by a reproducible procedure?
texte.La conduite du chantier au nom du maître: Running the site on behalf of the project owner. Entirely in the works phase — unticking it means not being represented on site.
texte.La demande existe-t-elle, le calendrier: Does the demand exist, does the timetable hold against access to electricity, from what occupancy does the site cover its costs. Eight tests that feed into the SAME verdict as the costing. The eight findings are shown in the file of the country you open on the map, under the envelope.
texte.La donnée est-elle qualifiée : périmètre: Is the data qualified: scope, unit, calculation method, known uncertainty?
texte.La décision est chiffrée ; elle n’est pa: The decision is costed; it has not been examined.
texte.La maturité analytique n'est jamais un é: Analytical maturity is never a fixed state: without prioritised actions or a reassessment milestone, the diagnosis becomes a finding re-read a year later, unchanged.
texte.La preuve que l'installation fait ce qu': Proof that the installation does what it promises — integrated tests, ramp-up, switchovers. Its rate is TEN TIMES higher on the technical package, and it is the engagement that sets a data centre apart from a warehouse: without it, the announced availability is never demonstrated.
texte.La puissance informatique et l’enveloppe: The IT power and the construction works envelope are taken from the study above.
texte.La suite du panorama : une fois le terra: The next step after the overview: once the site is located, this module costs — investment envelope, breakdown by DPGF lot, comparison between countries, value creation — and it TESTS the business case: does the demand exist, does the timetable hold against access to electricity, from what occupancy level does the project cover its costs.
texte.La vitesse s’achète : jusqu’à +# % const: Speed can be bought: up to +# % observed on the market.
texte.Le bilan énergie-eau-carbone, ou la séqu: The energy-water-carbon inventory, or the sequence of documents — and, on the engineering site, the rest of the money chain: the cost of works item by item, then the fees they carry, with a technical share CALCULATED instead of assumed.

texte.Le calcul répond quand même à la questio: The calculation still answers the question that decides:
texte.Le calendrier et l'articulation des entr: The timetable and the coordination of contractors. Its weight DOUBLES on the technical package, where the most trades cross on the same square metre.
texte.Le chiffrage lui-même : quantitatifs, ra: The costing itself: quantities, ratios, price breakdown by work package, contingencies, price revision, variance from budget. It is not the coordination of the costing — it is the costing. On an operation where the technical package carries most of the weight, a ratio per square metre means nothing and the take-off is done per IT kilowatt. — RATE NOT RECORDED: The recorded breakdown does not distinguish the cost consultant: on this operation, the costing was carried by the architect and the building services consultant. That is not general practice, and certainly not on a data centre where the technical package makes up most of the envelope.
texte.Le dossier d'installation classée, entiè: The classified installation file, entirely upstream. A data centre falls under ICPE headings because of its generators and its refrigerants — to be checked case by case.
texte.Le maintien dans la durée est-il organis: Is long-term upkeep organised — who reassesses, when, and what does a gap trigger?
texte.Le même calcul répond à deux questions,: The same calculation answers two questions, which is why this block appears in both views.
texte.Le parti d'ensemble, l'insertion, les au: The overall concept, site integration, permits. On a data centre, its weight lies in the building envelope: the IT room is designed around the fluids, not the facade.
texte.Le poste que les quatorze lots ne contie: The item the fourteen work packages do not contain — and which weighs a third of the investment when you carry it.
texte.Le profil de l’installation — puissance,: The installation profile — power, size, cooling, country — goes to the sustainability study, which calculates the PUE, water and carbon, then the decarbonisation trajectory.
texte.Le qualitatif est-il instruit avec la mê: Is the qualitative side examined with the same rigour — interviews, operator opinions, incident feedback — and traced?
texte.Les KPI de pilotage sont-ils arrêtés, ch: Are the steering KPIs set, each with its owner and review frequency?
texte.Les actions d'amélioration sont-elles id: Are the improvement actions identified, each with an owner and a deadline?
texte.Les centres recensés, leur statut, leur: The centres listed, their status, their size and the confidence of each source; estate footprint and limits of the estimate.
texte.Les chiffres ci-dessus préparent une déc: The figures above prepare an investment decision. This diagnosis answers the other question, the one rarely asked before ordering a dashboard:
texte.Les critères de maturité attendus sont-i: Are the expected maturity criteria written down, with a quantified threshold per criterion?
texte.Les honoraires, phase par phase et missi: The fees, phase by phase and engagement by engagement, on the works amount for the selected country.
texte.Les méthodes quantitatives sont-elles te: Are the quantitative methods maintained — series, variances, sensitivity to assumptions?
texte.Les quatorze lots ci-dessus s'arrêtent a: The fourteen work packages above stop at the walls, the fluids and the electricity. Work package
texte.Les sources nécessaires à chaque KPI son: Are the sources needed for each KPI identified by name, including external sources (market, energy, land)?
texte.Les étapes de la décision d’enveloppe: The steps of the envelope decision
texte.Les études spécialisées qu'on ne sait pa: The specialist studies nobody can name at the start and that always end up being commissioned.
texte.L’enveloppe dit ce que le projet: The envelope says what the project
texte.L’enveloppe en fourchette, la DPGF par l: The envelope as a range, the DPGF [itemised lump-sum price breakdown] per work package, the total cost and the payment schedule.
texte.L’organisation a-t-elle de quoi instruir: Does the organisation have what it takes to examine this decision, then follow its execution? To be asked before promising a dashboard.
texte.Maturité analytique — l'entreprise peut-: Analytical maturity — can the company examine this decision?
texte.Neuve, extension ou reprise : les lots n: New build, extension or refurbishment: the work packages do not weigh the same.
texte.Ni enveloppe, ni coût unitaire, ni prix: No envelope, no unit cost, no electricity price: an address gets copied and logged.
texte.Nomenclature des équipements informatiqu: IT equipment bill of materials and its carbon, EVA / ROCE / free cash flow, maturity diagnosis and steering dashboard — each block as the page calculated it, with its refusals and uncertainties.

texte.Preuve attendue : La liste des KPI avec,: Expected evidence: The list of KPIs with, alongside each, a name and a frequency.

texte.Preuve attendue : Le dictionnaire de don: Expected evidence: The data dictionary, or the indicator records.
texte.Preuve attendue : Le document qui les po: Expected evidence: The document that carries them, dated and circulated.
texte.Preuve attendue : Le flux ou la procédur: Expected evidence: The flow or the procedure, and its last run.

texte.Preuve attendue : Les comptes rendus, et: Expected evidence: The minutes, and what they changed.

texte.Projet et dossier de consultation des en: Detailed design and tender documents — The documents on which contractors submit their prices: specifications, outline construction drawings, DPGF.
texte.Puissance, gabarit, scénario, calendrier: Power, template, scenario, timetable — the engineering criteria under “Go further”, and the BUSINESS CASE under its own drop-down: hosting price, contracted power, year of firm power. Without them, the verdict will speak only of construction.
texte.Quel BFR le plan retient-il, une fois le: What working capital requirement does the plan assume, once the site is in steady state?
texte.Quel CMPC le comité d'investissement ret: What WACC does the investment committee apply to this asset class, and over what period?
texte.Quel montant annuel de renouvellement le: What annual replacement amount does the plan provide for — UPS, generators, BMS?
texte.Quel revenu annuel le plan d'affaires re: What annual revenue does the business plan assume at full load, and from which year does it reach it?
texte.Quel taux effectif s'applique au véhicul: What effective rate applies to the vehicle that will hold the asset, after credits and exemptions?
texte.Quelle durée le plan comptable retient-i: What period does the accounting plan use for the structural works and for the technical packages?

texte.Recalibrer une ambition en ouverture coû: Recalibrating an ambition at the outset costs a meeting; explaining six months later why the dashboard is not used costs the project — and the trust that came with it. The debrief note below carries the verdict at the top, never in an annex.
